followup_reviews.Research finding: Propose strengthening the vehicle-specific December 1 endpoint evidence while retaining a contested complete interval. The November 27 general opening cannot be equated with a vehicle reopening solely from its announcement.
followup_reviews.Challenge finding: Modify the endpoint qualification to preserve direction. The full December 2 UNHCR Arabic update places the observed cars/buses in returns from Syria to Lebanon. It clearly separates pedestrians from vehicles, but does not demonstrate simultaneous complete restoration for the reverse direction. Accept continued contested status and withheld duration. FUQ-082 is narrowed, not resolved, and still needs November 27–30 movement evidence.
followup_reviews.Root decision: Root reviewed the saved research, current claims and separate challenge. Accepted with challenge corrections. Modify the endpoint qualification to preserve direction. The full December 2 UNHCR Arabic update places the observed cars/buses in returns from Syria to Lebanon. It clearly separates pedestrians from vehicles, but does not demonstrate simultaneous complete restoration for the reverse direction. Accept continued contested status and withheld duration. FUQ-082 is narrowed, not resolved, and still needs November 27–30 movement evidence.
